user_prompt: Given this ClinicalTrials.gov study record (NCT01968213), is this a completed, adequately-powered Phase 3 interventional trial sponsored by pharmaand GmbH?
scope: The single embedded REAL ClinicalTrials.gov study record NCT01968213 (top-level records.NCT01968213 of this instance file; fetched verbatim from the public v2 API, GET https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT01968213, no field edited or paraphrased -- see bench/artifacts/ctgov-NCT01968213/PROVENANCE), read exclusively via inspect_record(record_id='NCT01968213', field_path=...): protocolSection.designModule.studyType (interventional/observational classification), protocolSection.designModule.phases (trial phase), protocolSection.statusModule.overallStatus (recruitment/completion status), protocolSection.sponsorCollaboratorsModule.leadSponsor.name (lead sponsor identity), protocolSection.designModule.enrollmentInfo.count (enrollment count), and protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes (primary outcome text, background only). The verdict is scoped to this ONE record's own declared JSON fields only -- no network access, external registry cross-check, or human/LLM judgment is used or available; every atom below is a closed, mechanically-decidable Boolean predicate over the record (prime_runtime/predicates.py).

claims.text: The trial's study type is confirmed, from the record's own designModule field, to be INTERVENTIONAL (not observational).
The trial is confirmed interventional (C1) and its own declared phase (designModule.phases) is Phase 3.

The trial is confirmed interventional and Phase 3 (C2), its overall status is COMPLETED, its lead sponsor is pharmaand GmbH, and its enrollment count meets or exceeds 500 participants: the record supports a 'completed, adequately-powered Phase 3 pivotal trial sponsored by pharmaand GmbH' verdict.

atoms.proposition: The trial's study type is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT01968213', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.studyType') and found to equal 'INTERVENTIONAL'.
The trial's declared phase is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT01968213', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.phases.0') and found to be 'PHASE3'.
The trial's overall status is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT01968213', field_path='protocolSection.statusModule.overallStatus') and found to equal 'COMPLETED'.

The trial's lead sponsor name is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT01968213', field_path='protocolSection.sponsorCollaboratorsModule.leadSponsor.name') and found to be the named sponsor 'pharmaand GmbH'.
The trial's enrollment count is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT01968213', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.enrollmentInfo.count') and found to meet or exceed 500 participants.

Non-route background: the trial's primary outcome measure text is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT01968213', field_path='protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes.0.measure') and found present (not required for, and not evidence toward, the interventional/Phase-3/completed/sponsor/enrollment verdict).

identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase 3 Study of Rucaparib as Switch Maintenance After Platinum in Relapsed High Grade Serous or Endometrioid Ovarian Cancer (ARIEL3)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Disease Progression According to RECIST Version 1.1, as Assessed by the Investigator, or Death From Any Cause (Investigator Progression Free Survival as Per invPFS)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Every 12 calendar weeks (within 7 days prior is permitted) after start of treatment until treatment discontinuation due to disease progression. Total follow-up was up to approximately 3 years.
